preconditions: source-preserving terminology profiles exist for each input domain
decisionLogic: normalize BED descriptions only as engineering/geotechnical field descriptions
normalize GSJ polygon legends only as geological map-unit and petrologic concepts
classify volcanic-ash soil versus volcanic ash as genetic material association, never unit identity
require petrologic evidence before relating a field-described volcanic rock to an igneous map lithology
leave unknown labels and source codes unmapped
uncertainty: cross-domain associations are qualitative diagnostics and cannot establish stratigraphic identity
exclusions: no field-description to formal JGS classification without tests
validationMethod: exact source match, unknown-term fail-closed, cross-domain association and non-authorization tests plus actual Aso comparison matrix
reopenCondition: laboratory classifications, petrographic/geochemical evidence or an authoritative cross-domain ontology becomes available
